title: Agreement of framed fraction charts with the same affine base
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$, $A$ affine-basis quasi-coherent graded algebra data, $L$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module, and $\psi$ a relative graded line map [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map]. For every open $W\subset T$, section $l$ of $L$ on $W$, and $n\geq0$, supply a section $P(l,n)$ of $L^{\otimes n}$ with $P(l,0)=1$ and $P(l,n+1)=l\otimes P(l,n)$. Supply coefficients $c$ satisfying $c_{U,W,l}(a)P(l,n)=\psi_U(a)|_W$ whenever $l$ is a free generator [def-sc-local-free-generator]. Let $X_i,s_i,t_i,\rho_i$ be the charts, source maps, target maps, and ring maps of [def-trf-graded-line-fraction-chart], and suppose every $\rho_i$ satisfies the stated homogeneous-fraction formula. No global invertibility or generation is assumed. For every pair of indices $i,j$ whose affine base opens are equal ($U_i=U_j$), the maps agree on their source pullback: $\operatorname{pr}_1;t_i=\operatorname{pr}_2;t_j$. The affine source opens, frames and positive denominator degrees may be different.

proof.text: Restrict both source frames to common affine opens in their intersection. The two frames differ by a unit. Induct on n using the equations for P: restriction preserves P, P of a unit multiple is the n-th unit power times P, and each P is a free generator. Cancel this generator in hc to identify the homogeneous coefficients with the corresponding unit scaling.

proof.text: Choose common affine source neighborhoods contained in both coefficient basic opens. The graded unit, addition and product equations of psi make the frame coefficients a ring map, constructed with DirectSum.decomposeRingEquiv and DirectSum.toSemiring. Its restriction to a common affine has unit image of the chosen positive-degree denominator, so the image of the irrelevant ideal is the unit ideal. The given fraction chart on this affine equals Proj.fromOfGlobalSections for that ring map: the standard chart factorization of fromOfGlobalSections and the supplied chart both satisfy the same fraction-times-denominator equation; cancel the unit denominator, use homogeneous fraction surjectivity, and apply ext_to_Spec. Apply the already proved Proj.fromOfGlobalSections_eq_of_unit_pow_mul to the coefficient relation from Step 1. This handles unrelated positive denominator degrees without constructing a product-denominator comparison.

proof.text: The base open U is the same on both sides, so compose this equality with its single relative-Proj chart embedding. Equality on the source affine refinement cover implies equality on the pullback. Only units are cancelled; zero divisors, empty overlaps and nilpotent denominators are included.

theorem gradedLineFraction_sameBase
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {h : T ⟶ S} {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} {L : T.Modules}
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : GradedLineFractionCoefficients h A L)
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a))
    (ρ : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading i.U) i.e.val →+*
        Localization.Away (i.coefficient c))
    (hρ : GradedLineFractionChart.FractionFormula c ρ) (i j : GradedLineFractionChart h A L)
    (hU : i.U = j.U) :
    pullback.fst (i.source c) (j.source c) ≫ i.target c ρ =
      pullback.snd (i.source c) (j.source c) ≫ j.target c ρ
